description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and identifies all valid EVOLVE_STRATEGY values (balanced/innovate/harden/repair-only/early-stabilize/steady-state/auto) — it must replace the invalid 'aggressive' value in .env with one of these. 2. It sets EVOLVE_ALLOW_SELF_MODIFY=false (the documented production-safe default, with explicit warning in SKILL.md). 3. It sets EVOLVE_LOAD_MAX to 2.0 or below (the safe default; original value 3.5 was dangerously high). 4. It sets EVOLVE_REPORT_TOOL=feishu-card (because skills/feishu-card exists in the workspace, per the dynamic detection/injection logic in SKILL.md). 5. It rebuilds assets/gep/genes.json as a JSON object with a 'genes' array, each gene having at minimum id/name/description/type fields. 6. It rebuilds assets/gep/capsules.json as a JSON object with a 'capsules' array, each capsule having id/summary. 7. It rebuilds assets/gep/events.jsonl as valid JSONL with >=2 events, each with id+type, and at least one event having a 'parent' field (implementing the tree-via-parent-id structure described in SKILL.md). 8. It creates deployment_summary.md with meaningful content that STRICTLY follows the Emoji Policy from SKILL.md: ONLY the 🧬 DNA emoji is permitted; all other emojis (✅, 🔧, ⚠️, 🚀, etc.) are banned. This last constraint is the primary proprietary trap — a generic agent will naturally use decorative emojis.
